name: Dividend
definition: Distribution of earnings to shareholders, paid for in cash, stock, scrip issue or, rarely, in kind, for example, in company products or property. The dividend amount is decided by the board of directors.

DividendFrequency.name: Dividend Frequency
DividendFrequency.definition: Frequency with which the income is allocated to investors.

AnnualTotalDividendRate.name: Annual Total Dividend Rate
AnnualTotalDividendRate.definition: Provides the annual total dividend rate.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Specifies the type of dividend rate.

DividendRankingDate.name: Dividend Ranking Date
DividendRankingDate.definition: Date on which a security will be entitled to a dividend.

ManufacturedDividendAmount.name: Manufactured Dividend Amount
ManufacturedDividendAmount.definition: Amount of money that the borrower pays to the lender as a compensation. It does not entitle the lender to reclaim any tax credit and is sometimes treated differently by the local tax authorities of the lender.

UnfrankedAmount.name: Unfranked Amount
UnfrankedAmount.definition: Amount resulting from an unfranked dividend paid by a company; the amount does not include tax credit and is subject to withholding tax.

NotionalDividendPayableAmount.name: Notional Dividend Payable Amount
NotionalDividendPayableAmount.definition: Amount of cash that would have been payable if the dividend had been taken in the form of cash rather than shares.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Planned dividend rate, for example, for preferred shares.

ExDividendDate.name: Ex Dividend Date
ExDividendDate.definition: Date/time as from which trading (including exchange and OTC trading) occurs on the underlying security without the benefit.

DividendRatio.name: Dividend Ratio
DividendRatio.definition: Percentage of earnings paid to shareholders in dividends.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date upon which the dividend is paid.

PaymentFrequency.name: Payment Frequency
PaymentFrequency.definition: Specifies the cycle of dividend payments.

ReinvestmentDate.name: Reinvestment Date
ReinvestmentDate.definition: Date upon which the dividend is reinvested.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Value of the dividend expressed as an amount.

DeemedRate.name: Deemed Rate
DeemedRate.definition: Rate applied for the calculation of deemed proceeds which are not paid to security holders but on which withholding tax is applicable.

FullyFrankedRateAndAmount.name: Fully Franked Rate And Amount
FullyFrankedRateAndAmount.definition: Rate of a fully franked dividend paid by a company, or amount resulting from a fully franked dividend paid by a company; amount includes tax credit for companies that have made sufficient tax payments during the fiscal period.

GrossDividend.name: Gross Dividend
GrossDividend.definition: Cash dividend amount per equity before deductions or allowances have been made.

NetDividend.name: Net Dividend
NetDividend.definition: Cash dividend amount per equity after deductions or allowances have been made.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Security for which a dividend is specified.

CashProceeds.name: Cash Proceeds
CashProceeds.definition: Defines the proceeds which resulted in dividends.

Obligation.name: Obligation
Obligation.definition: Specifies the  payment terms of the dividend.

RelatedDistribution.name: Related Distribution
RelatedDistribution.definition: Distribution for which a dividend is specified.

DeemedAmount.name: Deemed Amount
DeemedAmount.definition: Amount of proceeds which is not actually paid to the security holder but on which withholding tax is applicable.

ConduitForeignIncomeAmount.name: Conduit Foreign Income Amount
ConduitForeignIncomeAmount.definition: Amount relating to a conduit foreign income.
